metadata.title: Daily Tarot Question | tarot-spark
metadata.description: Meet one card from tarot-spark's 12-card Major Arcana preview and reflect on one question for today.

heading: One card. One question for today.
intro: Use today's card as a small pause for self-reflection. The same card returns throughout your local calendar day.
deckNote: This experiment draws from tarot-spark's current 12-card Major Arcana preview.
disclaimer: Tarot content is for entertainment and self-reflection only. It is not medical, legal, financial, or mental-health advice.
